text.description_html:
AL-PRE Alarn lock Reader/Enroller For Digital Locks

Alarm Lock Prox Reader / Enroller (For Use With Prox Lock).

Prox Card Reader / Enroller Enables instant, automatic enrollment of Prox Cards into DL-Windows (just tap the Prox Card / fob device to the unit's faceplate to enroll)!

Supports all prox cards and prox keyfobs.

Simultaneous card enrollment, downloading or lock polling all on just one serial port. Replaces AL-PCI. 9V Battery operation (6 mos. to 1 year, typical).
